apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4 Debug
apps.localizedDescription: Defaults native 4:4:4 to the desktop profile that delivered hardware H.265 10-bit HDR in a live comparison. Adds experimental native touch with 4:4:4 through an opt-in Windows tablet request; host digitizer support is unverified. Set Touch Mode Always, enable the new Input toggle and start a fresh session to test. Retains 4:2:0 touch and all Metal 4 rendering/effects controls. 201 simulator tests passed, zero failures and one skip. Unsigned experimental build.
